**Mininet 2.3.0**

Premade VM images are available for recent Ubuntu LTS releases. 

We recommend the [Ubuntu 20.04.1 VM image](https://github.com/mininet/mininet/releases/download/2.3.0/mininet-2.3.0-210211-ubuntu-20.04.1-legacy-server-amd64-ovf.zip) unless you require an earlier release.
